# fluss-go v0.1.0-beta.3

This prerelease publishes the documentation hardening completed after
v0.1.0-beta.2. It does not change the Apache Fluss 0.9.1 wire protocol or add a
new public data API.

## Highlights

- Expanded pkg.go.dev contracts for typed data APIs, extension interfaces,
  configuration, ownership, partial failures, and pre-v1 stability.
- Added production TLS and SASL PLAIN configuration guidance.
- Added error classification, safe-retry, uncertain-writer recovery, and
  partial-result workflows.
- Added advanced `fadm` guidance for cluster settings, server tags, rebalances,
  producer offsets, snapshot leases, filesystem credentials, lake snapshots,
  and table statistics.
- Added compile-checked examples for data, authentication, recovery, and
  administration workflows.
- Added deterministic local Markdown link, heading-anchor, and Go snippet
  validation to CI.
- Documented row, binary array and map, and record-batch wire layouts against
  the pinned Apache Fluss 0.9.1 fixtures.

See the [full changelog](../../CHANGELOG.md) and the
[documentation index](../../README.md#documentation).

This is a pre-v1 release. Pin the version and review the changelog before
upgrading.
